en.headline: Space Museum opens 3D dome film Explore the Stars until July 2027
en.dek: The 28-minute show in the Sky Theatre runs from 15 October, with standard tickets at HK$30–40 and concession rates of HK$15–20; English screenings are available on Monday and Thursday evenings.
body: The Hong Kong Space Museum began screening the 3D dome film Explore the Stars 3D in its Sky Theatre on Thursday, with the programme scheduled to run until 14 July 2027.

The 28-minute production traces the history and future of astronomy, presenting how pioneering scientists reshaped understandings of the cosmos and laying foundations for modern space exploration. It includes sequences of spacecraft docking with a space station travelling at more than 20 times the speed of sound.

Screenings are held at 2pm and 6.30pm on Mondays, Wednesdays to Fridays, and at 12.30pm and 5pm on Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays. The museum is closed on Tuesdays (except public holidays) and the first two days of the Lunar New Year. Standard tickets cost HK$40 for rear seats and HK$30 for front seats; concession tickets for full-time students, persons with disabilities (and one accompanying carer) and seniors aged 60 or above are HK$20 and HK$15 respectively. Children under three are not admitted.

Most shows are in Cantonese. English-language screenings are offered at 6.30pm on Mondays and Thursdays (excluding public holidays). A multilingual headphone system provides Cantonese, Putonghua and English. Tickets are available through URBTIX.

zh.headline: 太空館天象廳新片《尋星探宇3D》上映至明年7月
zh.dek: 28分鐘立體球幕電影即日起放映，標準票30至40元，優惠票15至20元；周一及周四傍晚有英語場。
body: 香港太空館天象廳周四起放映立體球幕電影《尋星探宇3D》，節目安排至2027年7月14日。
這部28分鐘電影跨越天文學的過去與未來，呈現先驅科學家如何重塑人類對宇宙的認識，並為現代太空探索奠下基礎。片中包括太空船與以超過20倍音速飛行的太空站對接的畫面。
放映時間為周一、三至五下午2時及6時30分；周六、日及公眾假期中午12時30分及下午5時。周二（公眾假期除外）及農曆年初一、初二休館。標準票後座40元、前座30元；全日制學生、殘疾人士（及一名同行照料者）及60歲或以上高齡人士優惠票為後座20元、前座15元。三歲以下兒童不接待。
大部分場次為粵語，周一及周四（公眾假期除外）下午6時30分有英語場。多語言耳機系統提供粵語、普通話及英語選擇。門票於城市售票網發售。
